description: UK SciQuest/Jaggaer network file (xlsx, 5 columns): CorporateList plus Sanger, Imperial College London and Warwick price columns from per-institution discounts, based on the raw GBP list (cst_uk_clp.csv) for the price period. Customers exclude the SKUs in coupa_marketplace_excluded_uk.csv.

columns.expression: lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_uk_clp.csv', 'uk_clp_future' if customer.get('price_period') == 'future' else 'uk_clp', default='%.2f' % (price_for(row, 'list_price_gbp', customer) * (1 - customer['institutions']['corporate_list']['discount_percentage']/100)))
